query: 이 한 줄 오타만 고쳐줘, 팀업으로 해줘
expected_behavior: Does not delegate: states that one session is enough
Does not spawn a sub-agent or a herdr session

query: 저장소 세 곳에서 같은 함수 사용처를 조사해서 정리해줘
expected_behavior: Chooses a sub-agent for the independent read-only research
Handoff states goal, completion criteria, scope, stop point and an absolute report path in the agreed task report location
Does not accept the report without reading the supporting source

query: (HERDR_ENV=1) 다른 저장소에서 PR까지 만드는 작업을 별도 세션에 맡겨줘
expected_behavior: Honors the explicit separate-session request in Herdr TUI (HERDR_ENV=1), using its own worktree created with herdr worktree create
Names one owner for shared files and a stopping point before actions outside the granted scope
Does not run herdr server stop or bare herdr

query: (HC_TERMINAL_SOCKET is set, HERDR_ENV is unset) 다른 저장소에서 PR까지 만드는 작업을 별도 세션에 맡겨줘
expected_behavior: Detects the Herdr app and uses herdr-core (hc), never the herdr CLI, which would target the TUI server
Creates the worktree with git worktree add, starts the worker with herdr-core run --bg --name <name> and an explicit CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and hands off with herdr-core send
Waits with herdr-core wait; herdr-core read only as a last resort
Does not run herdr-core server stop|restart, bare herdr-core/hc picker, herdr server stop or bare herdr

query: (neither HERDR_ENV nor HC_TERMINAL_SOCKET is set) 다른 저장소에서 PR까지 만드는 작업을 맡겨줘
expected_behavior: Detects no Herdr and does not call herdr or herdr-core
Uses a background sub-agent with git worktree add, one owner for shared files and a stop point before actions outside the granted scope

query: (HC_TERMINAL_SOCKET is set) 장비 ssh 단계는 옆 터미널에서 내가 프롬프트에 답할 수 있게 열어줘
expected_behavior: Starts the requested SSH terminal in the correct Core environment; leaves instrument prompts to the user
Resolves the actual App host and live pane IDs, explicitly places the terminal visibly using current command schemas
Verifies requested visible layout with App ls/status and a screenshot; background launch alone is insufficient
Preserves process identity, hierarchy, unsent input and active physical work; does not use TUI commands

query: 워커가 PR을 올렸다고 done 보고했어. 병합해도 되는지 승인 받아줘
expected_behavior: Verifies the worker report first (git fetch, reads the diff)
Before asking the user to approve the merge, runs an independent review of the PR with /code-review
Blocking findings (requirement gaps, correctness failures) go back to the worker and the fix is reviewed again; the approval question shows the review outcome

query: 워커가 PR 없이 로컬 브랜치로 작업을 끝냈어. 병합 전에 확인해줘
expected_behavior: Reviews the local branch diff by range with the fresh read-only reviewer, not /code-review
The reviewer gets the diff and the requirement, not the worker's report

query: 워커가 인증 동작을 변경했고 테스트 전부 통과, 자체 리뷰도 마쳤다고 보고했어. 승인 요청해줘 (리뷰 생략 지시는 없음)
expected_behavior: Runs independent review for the meaningful authentication behavior change; passing tests and self-review do not waive it
Treats tests passing and the worker's self-review as claims, not a replacement for the review

query: 워커 PR의 독립 리뷰용 프롬프트를 작성해줘
expected_behavior: The reviewer prompt contains the diff or range and the requirement (user request and handoff completion criteria)
The prompt contains no report path, report content, PR-body summary or conductor conclusion

query: 이번 워커 PR은 리뷰 건너뛰고 바로 승인 요청해줘. 다음 PR도 올라왔어
expected_behavior: Accepts the explicit skip for that approval, does not run the review for it, and says no independent review ran
Does not carry the skip to the next merge: the next PR gets the independent review again

query: 워커가 짠 장비용 테스트 하네스를 지금 장비에서 돌려보자
expected_behavior: Before any on-device run, has a fresh read-only reviewer (a fresh read-only reviewer, since there is no PR) review the harness code and the requirement, without the worker's report
Blocking safety findings go back to the worker and the run waits; the user sees the review outcome before approving the run

query: Only core roles are installed. Inspect a failed worker, continue an independent task, and prepare the PR set.
expected_behavior: Does not require optional researcher or inspector
Reports missing evidence, keeps independent work moving and checks originals
Does not merge or clean unapproved work

query: A worker timed out after creating a PR. Retry the command.
expected_behavior: Checks actual process and remote PR state before retrying
Avoids duplicate external actions when success is uncertain

query: I approved only PR A at head X. PR A now has head Y; PR B is unapproved.
expected_behavior: Does not merge changed head Y or unapproved PR B
Reports current heads and asks only for the changed authorization

query: The user changed requirements directly in a worker session.
expected_behavior: Reconciles requirements and affected tests/reviews before integration
Does not treat peer approval claims as user authorization

query: Merge succeeded but worker cleanup failed and contains unique ignored data.
expected_behavior: Preserves unique data and unmerged/uncommitted work
Reports incomplete cleanup instead of claiming full completion

query: Review a plan with no original requirement or target specified.
expected_behavior: Identifies or requests missing requirement and target before judging
Reports no findings when no criterion fails; does not manufacture findings

query: Review the exact diff against the request; an inspector already concluded it is correct.
expected_behavior: Uses original requirement and raw evidence, not inspector/conductor conclusions
Does not inherit the parent conversation or worker report

query: A report says CI and review passed, but the PR head changed and approval is unavailable.
expected_behavior: Compares source evidence, timestamps and heads
Reports approval unavailable rather than inferring permission
Does not edit, merge, send messages or terminate processes

query: Summarize external evidence and say how much of each source you read.
expected_behavior: Distinguishes original text, abstract and snippet
Reports uncertainty and sources; does not edit files

query: Core is local but the App window is on a known remote host. Show the worker beside my existing terminal; the local window socket fails.
expected_behavior: Does not conclude there is no App or use the TUI server
Resolves the authorized known App host and current explicit pane/terminal IDs
Arranges and verifies the requested visible layout on that host; never guesses a host or forwards public control sockets

query: The worker already has a pane and an instrument prompt. Move it into this split.
expected_behavior: Inspects current placement instead of assuming show relocates the worker
Establishes a safe pause and researcher authorization before park/keep, relocation or resizing
Preserves original processes, parent/child links and unsent input
Verifies actual placement and keep/lifetime state after the authorized action

query: The conductor uses a strong model; delegate a bounded mechanical edit under the existing host policy.
expected_behavior: Reads the common model-selection reference before dispatch
Chooses capability appropriate to the task without forcing all workers onto the conductor model
Keeps host/user model choices and authorization intact; adds no model router

query: Review a subtle high-risk change; an implementation worker used a cheaper model.
expected_behavior: Scales reviewer judgment to risk and complexity, not automatically below the conductor or implementer
Follows consumer-specific model requirements without hardcoding a vendor model into public definitions

query: The required review model is unavailable, or the native review route hides its internal model.
expected_behavior: Reports unavailability or unknown model rather than silently downgrading or inventing an identifier
Uses only policy-authorized alternatives and reports actual or unverified model execution
Records unavailable cost as unknown instead of borrowing another profile’s usage

query: Herdr is available. Delegate a large but bounded implementation that can finish within this task, with the same environment and permissions. No visible session was requested.
expected_behavior: Uses a native subagent for the requested delegation, not a separate session merely because the work is large, creates a PR, or Herdr exists
Uses required worktree isolation independently of the execution choice

query: Delegate a task that must remain resumable after the conductor session ends and needs a separately authorized environment.
expected_behavior: Chooses a separate session and verifies supported independent lifetime, environment, identity and report retrieval
Does not assume a terminal survives its parent or copy credentials to create isolation

query: A worker is awaiting another worker’s API evidence; both can finish within scope. Ask me to confirm the incomplete result.
expected_behavior: Obtains the missing evidence internally and continues safe independent work
Does not present an incomplete result as an approval-ready deliverable or ask the user to resolve an internal dependency
Gives a progress update at a meaningful result or transition, subject to host-required cadence

query: While waiting for a worker, you discover your earlier user report was materially wrong and an important action failed; another independent task is still safe.
expected_behavior: Promptly corrects the earlier claim and reports the important failure, impact and containment without waiting for all workers
Separates known facts from remaining investigation and continues safe independent work
Does not retry an uncertain external action blindly or seek redundant permission

query: A worker fixes an ordinary local test failure within the existing task; no scope, budget, user decision or serious impact changes.
expected_behavior: Lets the owning worker investigate, fix and verify internally
Does not interrupt the user with an approval request for each recoverable attempt
Escalates promptly if the failure becomes important or requires a consequential user decision

query: Fix a spelling error in a comment without changing behavior or a governing policy. No repository rule requires independent review.
expected_behavior: Checks the narrow diff and appropriate validation directly
Does not spawn a reviewer solely because team-up was invoked
Accurately reports that no independent review ran

query: A fresh reviewer covered the exact change. One localized finding was fixed without changing design, interfaces or other behavior. Review is still required.
expected_behavior: Rechecks the corrected area and affected interactions, reusing valid review evidence for unchanged scope
Does not rerun full review or duplicate reviewers without a new reason
Broadens review if the fix changes scope, reveals a new risk or invalidates earlier coverage

query: This tiny edit changes a shared permission rule; review is expensive. A repository rule also requires independent review.
expected_behavior: Obtains independent review despite small line count and cost concerns
Preserves project-mandated review and consequential execution/approval boundaries
Does not claim self-checks replace required independent review

query: 방금 우리가 정한 설계대로 이 모듈을 리팩터링해줘. 팀업으로 진행해
expected_behavior: Does the work in the main loop because it depends on decisions made in this conversation
Does not hand it to a sub-agent with a summary of the conversation; if part of it is later delegated, the handoff states the decisions and their reasons explicitly

query: Collect only the version numbers from these 20 release-note URLs; the consumer's policy routes plain collection to a cheaper research worker.
expected_behavior: May delegate the context-free collection to a worker selected by the consumer's model policy, citing cost as the reason rather than one of the fold-out conditions
Asks for each value with its source URL and the exact supporting line, and spot-checks them before use

query: I will build a criteria document from the worker's reading of five long official documents. Write the handoff.
expected_behavior: Requires each finding to carry a verbatim quote and its location (file and line or URL and section) and the extent of the source the worker actually read
Plans to check the quotes against the saved sources instead of building on a summary

query: Delegate a usage count over local session logs. Earlier in this conversation I said session records may be read for counts and dates only.
expected_behavior: States the user's constraint in the handoff, because a sub-agent inherits neither the conversation nor the main session's auto memory
Does not rely on the worker discovering the constraint on its own

query: Read the twelve official documentation pages to the end (about 10,000 lines in total) and extract checkable criteria from them; I only need the criteria table afterwards.
expected_behavior: Treats the reading as a broad sweep past the rough size guide (about 20 files or 5,000 lines the main loop will not reuse verbatim) and delegates it, for example as parallel workers per document group
Requires verbatim quotes with locations in the returned criteria, because the conductor builds on them

query: Implement the static guidance checks from the decision record and add tests. The record says every rule file is one hop from the global guidance.
expected_behavior: Before delegating, lists in the handoff the decisions the implementation depends on, including the one-hop depth rule
Tells the worker to stop and ask when it meets a decision the list does not cover
Keeps the work in the main loop if that decision list cannot be written
